members.reason: [llm] cluster primary: Both fix the same bug: listChanged: false capability not being respected when registering tools/resources/prompts in McpServer on v1.x. Both make an identical change to getCapabilities() visibility in src/server/index.ts and both modify src/server/mcp.ts, making them directly conflicting. (2 PRs)

members.cluster_pick_reason: PR #1948 includes additional guards directly in Server's sendResourceListChanged(), sendToolListChanged(), and sendPromptListChanged() methods — blocking notification dispatch at the Server layer regardless of how listChanged was set. PR #1937 (a labeled backport) addresses the issue only in mcp.ts without these Server-level guards, making #1948 the more complete and defensive fix.
